estimates: The model represents the standing historic Circuit House, using its exact mapped perimeter, two-storey brick envelope, white plaster, red roof tiles, tall windows and documented upper verandah.
The three mapped facade projections constrain the principal masses. Gable profiles, sash arrangement, veranda bays, later exterior fittings, ornamental work and building levels remain estimates.
The original site height field is preserved. Entrance steps and foundation heights use an approximate local grade.

review.notes: Searched the local Qualla corpus first. The CC0 Schiphol portrait and the government-released 2026 interior do not show the building exterior. Used the measured museum footprint, operator, site survey and firsthand written evidence only.
